title: kbingest drift reads a suffix pointer's path instead of the source url's path
goal: When a CODE fact's pointer path is a suffix of its pinned source url's path (utils.ts#x against .../src/spec-node/utils.ts), drift reads the blob at the url's path at both commits and reports the fact by its real outcome, not unverifiable; a test named ingest_drift_suffix_pointer proves it (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F8)
